M22 — 2026-10-10
npm E401 'Unable to authenticate, your authentication token seems to be invalid' on npm access/trust/stage (and 401 on npm whoami) means the npm login session has expired: run npm login again, then retry. On 2026-10-10 the session that ran trust.mjs had expired a few hours later.
